mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST show positive growth (vs. prior month), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), weak supply conditions lead to higher input costs and potential inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.0% in a 3-month window, it signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rises > 1.0% in 3 months), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate above 8.0% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, strong growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals expanding aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during the post-recession recovery phase when RSAFS shows positive growth, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS show positive growth (vs. prior month), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
